question: How do I open the Ask AI panel using keyboard shortcuts?
ground_truth: To open the Ask AI panel, use Command + / on macOS or Ctrl + / on Windows/Linux. This shortcut is different from the single / key which opens the regular search dialog.

metadata.cited_context:

`Ctrl` + `/` (Windows/Linux) | The `Command`/`Ctrl` + `/` shortcut is different from the single `/` key which opens the regular [search dialog](#search).
